The Overgrown Outpost.name: The Overgrown Outpost
The Overgrown Outpost.description: A cluster of simple stone huts huddled in the shadow of a massive, cracked crystal spire.

tutorial_boss.name: The Weeping Guardian
tutorial_boss.description: A stone colossus from the Aurelian age stands dormant in the village ruins. It has begun to leak wild mana, poisoning the local wells.
objectives: Locate the Weeping Guardian in the Shattered Plaza
Find a way to soothe or dismantle the Guardian

metadata.guidelines: The Guardian is a relic of the old world, made of white marble and gold. It 'weeps' liquid mana from its eye-sockets. It is not inherently evil, but malfunctioning. Mention how the player's blood feels warm and begins to hum as they approach the colossus.

log: A millennium has passed since the Golden Age turned to ash. The name 'Aurelia' is now a whisper feared by the superstitious.
You are but a scavenger in the dirt, clutching a rusted locket—the only proof of a lineage long since forgotten by the world.
As you gaze at the cracked crystal spire above, your blood begins to tingle—a faint, ancient rhythm drumming beneath your skin.

story_history.choice_made: Recognized the call of the Aurelian Spire
